verdict.rationale: All options meet the stated early-afternoon arrival expectation, but each presents an unresolved tradeoff: A has a more comfortable one-stop connection but costs more and arrives later; B is cheapest with a comfortable connection but requires a very long layover and uses OAK; C arrives earliest but adds a second connection; D is relatively cheap and early but has a potentially risky 48-minute connection. No stated airport, price, arrival-time, or connection-risk preference resolves these tradeoffs.
